items.title_zh: 美国续行中国一次性钢瓶反倾销、反补贴令，10月14日起继续有效
items.title_en: US continues AD/CVD orders on Chinese non-refillable steel cylinders effective 14 October
items.title_original: Non-Refillable Steel Cylinders From the People's Republic of China: Continuation of Antidumping Duty Order and Countervailing Duty Order
items.summary_zh: 美国商务部根据其与USITC在首次五年日落复审中的肯定裁定，正式续行对中国一次性钢瓶的反倾销令A-570-126和反补贴令C-570-127，有效日期为2026年10月14日。范围包括符合或按照美国交通部Specification 39、加拿大39M或ISO 11118制造的焊接或钎焊便携式不可重复充装钢瓶，水容积300立方英寸（4.9升）至1526立方英寸（25升），可带或不带阀门/泄压装置、进口时可为空瓶；装压缩空气且符合描述的产品也包括。无缝一次性钢瓶明确排除。列示HTSUS 7311.00.0060、7311.00.0090，并可能从7310.29.0025、7310.29.0050进入，但书面范围优先。美国海关将继续按进口时有效税率收取反倾销和反补贴现金保证金；本通知没有公布一项适用于所有企业的新统一税率。
items.summary_en: Commerce has continued AD order A-570-126 and CVD order C-570-127 on non-refillable steel cylinders from China following affirmative Commerce and USITC sunset-review determinations, effective 14 October 2026. The scope covers specified welded or brazed portable cylinders of 4.9–25 litre water capacity made to USDOT 39, Transport Canada 39M or ISO 11118 requirements; seamless non-refillable cylinders are excluded. Listed HTSUS numbers are 7311.00.0060/0090 and potentially 7310.29.0025/0050, but the written scope controls. CBP will continue cash deposits at rates in effect on entry; the notice does not announce one new uniform rate.
items.impact_zh: 中国钢瓶生产商和出口商应立即按结构（焊接/钎焊或无缝）、容积、适用标准、是否带阀以及书面范围复核对美订单，不能仅凭HTS编码判断。报价和合同应沿用企业/组合在入境日适用的反倾销、反补贴保证金安排，并让美国进口商核对CBP指令；“续行”意味着现行令继续，不代表所有企业税率相同，也不应从本公告推算具体税额。
items.impact_en: Review US orders against construction, capacity, standards, valve configuration and the written scope, not HTS codes alone. Price using the producer/exporter combination and cash-deposit instructions applicable on entry; continuation does not create one uniform rate.

source.name: U.S. Federal Register / 美国联邦公报

items.source_excerpt: As a result of the determinations by the U.S. Department of Commerce (Commerce) and the U.S. International Trade Commission (ITC) that revocation of the antidumping duty (AD) and countervailing duty (CVD) orders on non-refillable steel cylinders the People's Republic of China (China) would likely lead to the continuation or recurrence of dumping, countervailable subsidies, and material injury to an industry in the United States, Commerce is publishing a notice of continuation of these AD and CVD orders.
items.follow_up: 下一次五年复审拟不迟于本次USITC裁定五周年前30天启动；当前订单应按入境日有效CBP保证金指令持续核对。

items.title_zh: 美国加速审查中俄乌定尺碳钢板措施：书面意见11月30日截止
items.title_en: US expedites reviews of CTL carbon steel plate measures; comments due 30 November
items.title_original: Cut-to-Length Carbon Steel Plate From China, Russia, and Ukraine; Scheduling of Expedited Five-Year Reviews
items.summary_zh: 美国国际贸易委员会（USITC）在第五次日落复审中决定采用加速程序，审查撤销中国定尺碳钢板反倾销令，以及终止俄罗斯、乌克兰同类产品暂停调查安排，是否会在可预见期间导致美国国内产业实质损害延续或再现。公告称国内产业答复充分、被调查方答复不充分，未发现需要全面复审的其他情形；案件被认定为“特别复杂”，复审期可延长最多90天。非公开工作人员报告拟于2026年11月23日提供给行政保护令名单人员，公开版随后发布；具备资格的当事方书面意见及非当事公众简短陈述原则上于11月30日17:15（美国东部时间）前提交，且不得加入新的事实资料。这是USITC程序安排，不是新税率或撤销措施决定。
items.summary_en: USITC has scheduled expedited fifth sunset reviews of the Chinese CTL carbon steel plate antidumping order and the suspended investigations concerning Russia and Ukraine. Domestic responses were adequate and respondent responses inadequate; the reviews were deemed extraordinarily complicated, permitting an extension of up to 90 days. The non-public staff report is scheduled for 23 November 2026 and eligible written comments are due by 5:15 p.m. ET on 30 November, without new factual information. This is a procedural notice, not a new duty rate or revocation decision.
items.impact_zh: 涉及对美定尺碳钢板业务的中国生产商、出口商和进口商不应把“加速审查”理解为现行反倾销令已经撤销或加税。应由美国案件律师核对当事方资格、行政保护令服务名单、书面意见权限及11月30日提交时限，并按书面产品范围判断具体货物；HTS编码只能辅助，不能替代范围描述。未参与前期答复的主体可能不具备提交评论资格，须逐案确认。
items.impact_en: Do not treat the expedited review as revocation or a new duty. Counsel should verify party eligibility, APO service-list status, filing rights and the 30 November deadline, and assess merchandise against the written scope rather than tariff codes alone.

source.name: U.S. Federal Register / 美国联邦公报

items.source_excerpt: The Commission hereby gives notice of the scheduling of expedited reviews pursuant to the Tariff Act of 1930 ("the Act") to determine whether revocation of the antidumping duty order on cut-to- length carbon steel plate from China and the termination of the suspended investigations on cut-to-length carbon steel plate from Russia and Ukraine would be likely to lead to continuation or recurrence of material injury within a reasonably foreseeable time.

follow_up.action_zh: 具备资格的当事方与律师核对USITC书面意见提交资格、APO服务和17:15美国东部时间截止；不得加入新事实资料。
follow_up.action_en: Eligible parties should confirm USITC filing rights, APO service and the 5:15 p.m. ET deadline; comments may not contain new factual information.

items.title_zh: 英国就将炼油产品纳入CBAM征求意见，反馈截止2027年1月20日
items.title_en: UK consults on adding refinery products to CBAM; responses due 20 January 2027
items.title_original: Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism (CBAM): a consultation on sectoral scope expansion to include refinery products
items.summary_zh: 英国财政部与税务海关总署发布开放咨询，拟在技术可行后尽快把部分炼油产品纳入英国CBAM；这不是已生效扩围，实施时间尚未确定。文件建议初期覆盖15个8位商品编码下的汽油、柴油、航空煤油和煤油：2710 1225、2710 1231、2710 1241、2710 1245、2710 1249、2710 1250、2710 1270、2710 1290、2710 1921、2710 1925、2710 1929、2710 1944、2710 1946、2710 1947、2710 1948；同时征询是否初期排除乙醇和FAME等低碳燃料，并按质量平衡扣除混合燃料中的低碳部分。拟议方法包括装置级统一强度、装置级重新分配以及生产过程级核算；氢可能作为前体计入。炼油产品默认值、原产炼厂/国家证明、行业税率及碳价减免仍待决定。咨询于2027年1月20日23:59截止。
items.summary_en: HM Treasury and HMRC opened a consultation on adding a subset of refinery products to UK CBAM as soon as feasible; no implementation date has been set and the scope expansion is not yet law. The proposal tests 15 eight-digit commodity codes covering petrol, diesel, jet fuel and kerosene: 2710 1225, 2710 1231, 2710 1241, 2710 1245, 2710 1249, 2710 1250, 2710 1270, 2710 1290, 2710 1921, 2710 1925, 2710 1929, 2710 1944, 2710 1946, 2710 1947 and 2710 1948. It asks whether neat low-carbon fuels such as ethanol and FAME should initially be excluded, with mass-balance treatment for blends. Installation-level and process-level emissions methods, hydrogen as a precursor, defaults, origin evidence, a refining-sector rate and carbon-price relief remain under consultation. Responses close at 11:59pm on 20 January 2027.
items.impact_zh: 本咨询不改变2027年起已覆盖钢铁的英国CBAM范围、钢铁税率或申报义务；对中国钢企的直接合规工作仍应按现行钢铁规则推进。间接影响可能来自英国物流、燃料和供应链成本，炼油方法也可能成为未来其他行业扩围的参考。集团如同时向英国出口成品油、经营贸易/仓储或掌握炼厂排放与原产追溯数据，应在2027年1月20日23:59前提交对商品编码、混合燃料质量平衡、炼厂追溯、默认值和成本传导的证据；不能据咨询稿预估确定税额。
items.impact_en: The consultation does not change the existing UK CBAM scope, rate or compliance duties for iron and steel from 2027. Steel exporters should continue preparing under the enacted steel rules. Indirect effects may arise through UK fuel, logistics and supply-chain costs, and the refinery methodology may inform later scope expansion. Groups that also export refined fuels, trade or store them, or hold refinery emissions/origin data should submit evidence on codes, blend mass balance, refinery traceability, defaults and cost pass-through by 11:59pm on 20 January 2027. Do not price a definite charge from this consultation.
items.source_excerpt: This consultation seeks views on the feasibility and impacts of CBAM sectoral scope expansion to refinery products. At Budget 2025, the government confirmed that it is considering the impacts and feasibility of including refinery products in CBAM in future. This consultation is the next stage of that ongoing assessment. This consultation is being undertaken jointly by His Majesty’s Revenue & Customs (HMRC) and His Majesty’s Treasury (HMT). The government invites views from interested parties, including the importers and their agents, other businesses, individuals, tax advisers, trade and professional bodies and other interested parties, including those overseas. Responses to the response form will be shared between HMRC and HMT. We use some essential cookies to make this website work. We also use cookies set by other sites to help us deliver content from their…
items.follow_up: 2027年1月20日23:59前可回应；后续跟踪政府答复、正式扩围法案、实施时间、最终商品编码、排放核算和默认值。
items.coverage: 2026-10-28已核读GOV.UK咨询页和44页官方PDF全文，核对咨询法律状态、截止时间、拟议15个炼油产品编码、低碳燃料/混合物方案、氢前体、三类排放分配方法、默认值、原产追溯、税率和实施安排；尚无政府答复、最终法案或实施日期。

items.title_zh: 中国钢材出口仍处高位、贸易救济增多：调查、裁决与已征税须逐案区分
items.title_en: China’s steel exports remain high as trade remedies rise; case status must be checked individually
items.title_original: 中国钢材出口遇难，20多国接连设限，钢铁行业进入寒冬
items.summary_zh: 这是一篇市场评论，不是政府措施或新的贸易救济决定。文章所引核心外贸数据可核对：2025年中国出口钢材11901.9万吨，同比增长7.5%，出口均价约693.8美元/吨、同比下降8.2%；2026年1—9月累计出口8564.1万吨，同比下降2.6%。文中“20多个国家和地区、98起贸易救济案件”可追溯至Mysteel依据中国贸易救济信息网公开记录所作的不完全汇总，其中混合了调查、裁决等不同节点，并非商务部发布的一项官方汇总统计，更不能理解为98项已经生效的新税。文章同时指出，发起调查不等于已经认定倾销或开始征税，这一区分是正确的；其关于行业“寒冬”和转型路径的表述属于作者判断。
items.summary_en: This is market commentary, not a government measure or a new trade-remedy decision. Core trade data can be cross-checked: China exported 119.019 million tonnes of steel products in 2025, up 7.5%, at an average price of about USD 693.8 per tonne, down 8.2%; exports in January–September 2026 were 85.641 million tonnes, down 2.6%. The claim of 98 trade-remedy cases across more than 20 jurisdictions traces to a Mysteel incomplete aggregation of public China Trade Remedies Information records. It combines investigations and determinations at different stages, is not a single official MOFCOM aggregate release, and does not mean 98 new duties are in force. The article correctly distinguishes initiation from a dumping finding or an effective duty; its broader “winter” and transformation narrative is commentary.
items.impact_zh: 中国钢厂和出口商不应把“98起”当作统一税负或市场关闭程度。实务上应建立按国家／地区、产品、HS税号、生产商—出口商组合、案件编号和法律阶段管理的台账，分别标注立案、初裁、临时措施、终裁、期终复审、保障措施及生效日期；报价前逐案核对税率、保证金、配额、原产地及熔炼浇铸证据。高端化和海外加工可以改善产品与市场结构，但境外加工并不会自动改变原产地或规避反规避审查，不能据评论稿直接调整税率、合同或投资判断。
items.impact_en: Chinese mills and exporters should not treat “98 cases” as a uniform tariff burden or a measure of market closure. Maintain a case matrix by jurisdiction, product, HS code, producer-exporter combination, case number and legal stage, separating initiation, preliminary determination, provisional measures, final measures, reviews, safeguards and effective dates. Before quoting, verify the applicable rate, deposits, quotas, origin and melt-and-pour evidence case by case. Higher-value products and overseas processing may improve market positioning, but foreign processing does not automatically change origin or avoid anti-circumvention scrutiny.
items.source_excerpt: 中国钢材出口遇难，20多国接连设限，钢铁行业进入寒冬 搜狐网
items.coverage: 2026-10-29已通读搜狐公开全文，并以国家统计局2025年公报、中钢协/海关数据核对2025全年及2026年1—9月出口量价；以Mysteel基于中国贸易救济信息网的汇总核对“98起/20多个国家”出处。未取得商务部发布的同口径结构化汇总，也未逐项复算98条案件，故明确保留为媒体/行业汇总。
items.follow_up: 持续按商务部中国贸易救济信息网及各调查机关原始公告更新案件台账；每个订单以适用产品、生产商、原产地、法律阶段和清关日期为准，不存在适用于全部“98起案件”的统一期限或税率。

items.title_zh: 日本决定对中国及台湾镍系冷轧不锈钢征收五年反倾销税，10月31日起实施
items.title_en: Japan decides five-year definitive anti-dumping duties on Chinese and Taiwanese nickel-added cold-rolled stainless steel from 31 October
items.title_original: Japan to Impose Anti-Dumping Duties of Up to 42.1% on Chinese, Taiwanese Stainless Steel Plate for 5 Years from Oct. 31
items.summary_zh: 日本财务省10月27日宣布，内阁已决定对原产于或从中国、台湾出口的镍系冷轧不锈钢带及冷轧板征收最终反倾销税；政令拟于10月30日公布，课税期为2026年10月31日至2031年10月30日。调查范围为含铬10.5%以上、镍0.6%以上的合金钢，涉及HS 7219.31—7219.35、7219.90、7220.20及7220.90项下22个税目。中国山西太钢及未抽样合作企业税率为27.7%，浦项（张家港）不锈钢（PZSS）及其他供应商为42.1%；台湾YUSCO及未抽样企业为3.6%，Walsin及其他供应商为20.1%。最终税率与7月9日起的临时税率相同。
items.summary_en: Japan's Ministry of Finance announced on 27 October that the Cabinet had decided definitive anti-dumping duties on nickel-added cold-rolled stainless steel coil, sheet and strip originating in or exported from China and Taiwan. The Cabinet Order is due to be promulgated on 30 October and duties will apply from 31 October 2026 through 30 October 2031. Scope covers alloy steel with at least 10.5% chromium and more than 0.6% nickel under 22 tariff lines within HS 7219.31-7219.35, 7219.90, 7220.20 and 7220.90. Rates are 27.7% for Shanxi Taigang and cooperating non-sampled Chinese suppliers, 42.1% for PZSS and other Chinese suppliers, 3.6% for YUSCO and cooperating non-sampled Taiwanese suppliers, and 20.1% for Walsin and other Taiwanese suppliers. These rates are unchanged from the provisional measure.
items.impact_zh: 这是已由日本内阁决定、即将公布并按明确日期实施的最终措施，不是提案。向日本出口相关冷轧不锈钢的中国钢厂和贸易商应在10月31日前按制造商身份、原产地/出口地和日本税目逐票复核适用税率；尤其不要把27.7%合作税率误用于PZSS或未获该待遇的供应商。报价和合同应明确反倾销税承担、在途货物清关日期及错误归类风险，并保存材质成分、宽度、轧制状态、制造商和原产地证明。该措施仅覆盖上述镍系冷轧不锈钢范围，不能外推到所有不锈钢板材。
items.impact_en: This is a definitive measure decided by Japan's Cabinet with a specified implementation date, not a proposal. Chinese mills and traders shipping covered cold-rolled stainless steel to Japan should verify the producer, origin/export route and Japanese tariff classification shipment by shipment before 31 October. Do not apply the 27.7% cooperating rate to PZSS or suppliers not entitled to it. Contracts and quotations should allocate anti-dumping duty, customs-clearance timing and misclassification risk, while retaining composition, width, rolling condition, producer and origin evidence. The measure covers the specified nickel-added cold-rolled products only, not all stainless plate.
items.status: 最终反倾销措施／10月31日起实施
items.source_excerpt: Japan to Impose Anti-Dumping Duties of Up to 42.1% on Chinese, Taiwanese Stainless Steel Plate for 5 Years from Oct. 31 BigGo Finance
items.coverage: 2026-10-28已通读日本财务省10月27日公告、英文暂译及10月19日特殊关税部会9页资料，核对法律状态、2026-10-31至2031-10-30期限、成分范围、22个税目所在HS项、四组生产商税率和调查结论。日本正式政令拟于10月30日公布，届时仍应以公布文本和具体日本税目为准。

follow_up.action_zh: 10月30日核对正式公布的政令及日本税目明细；10月31日起按生产商、原产地/出口地和清关日期确认税率，期限至2031年10月30日。
follow_up.action_en: Check the promulgated Cabinet Order and detailed Japanese tariff lines on 30 October; from 31 October confirm the rate by producer, origin/export route and customs-clearance date. The measure runs through 30 October 2031.

items.title_zh: 中国钢厂盈利走弱，铁矿石期货逼近四年低位
items.title_en: Iron ore futures near four-year lows as Chinese mill profitability weakens
items.title_original: Iron Ore Futures Near Four-Year Low on Weak Chinese Steel Demand
items.summary_zh: IndexBox 10月27日市场简报称，铁矿石期货周一跌向每吨670元人民币，接近四年低位；其引用的行业数据称，上周247家中国钢厂高炉开工率为80%，同比下降4.3%。同时，中国港口到货量偏高、全球发运增加，供应较充裕。报道还提到中国矿产资源集团与力拓达成新的供应安排，但具体条款未公开。
items.summary_en: IndexBox reported on 27 October that iron-ore futures moved toward CNY 670 per tonne on Monday, near four-year lows. It cited an 80% blast-furnace operating rate across 247 Chinese mills last week, down 4.3% year on year, alongside elevated port arrivals and rising global shipments. It also mentioned a new CMRG-Rio Tinto supply arrangement whose terms were not disclosed.
items.impact_zh: 这是市场信号，不是政策文件。原料价格下行有助于降低长流程钢厂采购成本，但其成因同时反映钢材需求和钢厂利润偏弱，不能据一日价格判断出口订单或利润已经改善。钢厂应分别跟踪现货矿价、钢材售价、库存和高炉利润；涉及中矿集团—力拓安排的采购判断，须等待双方可核实披露，不能把媒体所称口头通知当成公开合同条款。
items.impact_en: This is a market signal, not a policy measure. Lower ore prices can reduce blast-furnace input costs, but also reflect weak steel demand and mill margins; one day's price does not establish improved export profitability. Track spot ore, steel prices, inventories and furnace margins separately, and do not treat reported verbal notice of the CMRG-Rio Tinto arrangement as disclosed contract terms.
items.source_excerpt: Iron Ore Futures Near Four-Year Low on Weak Chinese Steel Demand - News and Statistics IndexBox

items.title_zh: GMK称乌克兰CBAM损失已高于欧委会预测，主张重算影响评估
items.title_en: GMK says Ukraine's CBAM losses already exceed the Commission forecast and calls for a reassessment
items.title_original: CBAM for Ukraine: why the European Commission should revise its impact assessment
items.summary_zh: GMK Center 10月27日分析称，2026年上半年乌克兰对欧盟、覆盖全部CBAM钢铁编码的出口额同比减少1.49亿欧元；其把供应链效应计入后，估算相当于约0.3%的GDP损失。GMK还预计，扁平材平均CBAM支付可能由2026年的78欧元/吨升至2030年的198欧元/吨，长材由61欧元/吨升至173欧元/吨，并主张欧委会把战争破坏、停产、能源和物流约束纳入重新评估。上述数据和预测是GMK模型结果及政策主张，不是欧盟正式豁免或税率决定。欧委会正式报告的基准是到2035年GDP影响约负0.01%，并非GMK文中所写的2031年。
items.summary_en: GMK Center said on 27 October that the value of Ukrainian iron and steel exports to the EU across all CBAM-covered codes fell by EUR 149 million year on year in H1 2026; including supply-chain effects, it estimates a GDP loss of about 0.3%. GMK projects average CBAM payments rising from EUR 78/t in 2026 to EUR 198/t in 2030 for flat products and from EUR 61/t to EUR 173/t for long products, and calls on the Commission to reassess war damage, shutdowns, energy and logistics constraints. These are GMK modelling results and policy requests, not an EU exemption or tariff decision. The Commission's formal report states an estimated GDP effect of about -0.01% by 2035, not 2031 as written in GMK's article.
items.impact_zh: 对中国钢厂的直接规则没有变化。该争议提示，第三国行业会以战争、发展水平和投资能力争取特殊或过渡安排；若乌克兰最终获得可执行优惠，可能改变其钢材在欧盟市场相对中国货源的竞争条件。但中国企业不能据此预期同等待遇，应继续准备经核查的产品级排放数据、测算不同EU ETS价格情景，并在DDP等合同中明确最终CBAM差额和核查失败风险。
items.impact_en: No rule for Chinese steel changes. The dispute shows that third-country industries may seek special or transitional treatment based on war damage, development level and investment capacity; any enforceable Ukraine-specific relief could alter its competitive position versus Chinese supply in the EU. Chinese firms should not assume comparable treatment and should continue preparing verified product-level emissions data, modelling ETS-price scenarios and allocating final CBAM and verification risks in DDP contracts.

follow_up.action_en: Monitor whether the Commission formally reopens its Ukraine CBAM assessment or proposes an enforceable temporary measure under Article 30(7); assume no exemption before an official act.

items.summary_zh: 韩国国家气候危机应对委员会与庆尚南道于10月26日在昌原举办第三次区域论坛，约200名政府、产业、学术和专家代表讨论全球碳监管、当地制造业转型和碳竞争力。韩国政府原始新闻稿显示，议题包括庆尚南道制造业EU CBAM应对、全球CBAM与韩国政策、世亚昌原特殊钢的低碳转型实践、出口竞争力以及企业碳数据利用。地方政府表示将加强机构协作并扩大企业可实际获得的支持。该活动是政策讨论和支持方向，不是新增税率、补贴方案或具有约束力的合规规则。
items.summary_en: South Korea's National Climate Crisis Response Commission and South Gyeongsang Province held their third regional forum in Changwon on 26 October, with about 200 government, industry, academic and expert participants. The official release lists sessions on EU CBAM strategy for regional manufacturing, global and Korean policy trends, SeAH Changwon Integrated Special Steel's transition, export competitiveness and corporate carbon data. Authorities promised stronger coordination and practical support. This is a policy forum and support direction, not a new duty, subsidy programme or binding compliance rule.
items.impact_zh: 对向欧盟供应钢铁、机械和金属制品的中国企业，这一消息本身不改变CBAM义务，但反映韩国同类出口商正把装置排放、核查、产品碳数据和地方支持结合起来。中国钢厂可据此检查与下游客户的数据接口和核查准备，但不应把论坛表态当作韩国已经推出具体补贴，亦不能据新闻推导产品税额或竞争成本。
items.impact_en: The forum does not change CBAM obligations but shows Korean competitors integrating installation emissions, verification, product data and local support. Chinese suppliers should test data interfaces and verification readiness without assuming a concrete Korean subsidy or inferring product-level costs.

items.title_en: India's commerce minister criticises EU steel curbs and CBAM; remarks do not change the rules
items.title_original: 'EU shooting itself in the foot': Piyush Goyal warns Europe over CBAM, import duty
items.summary_zh: 印度商务与工业部长皮尤什·戈亚尔（Piyush Goyal）在10月22日柏林全球对话上批评欧盟钢铁进口限制、CBAM及其他监管要求，认为这些措施会推高钢、铝、水泥及基础设施成本，削弱欧洲竞争力，并可能引发贸易伙伴的对等措施。他同时强调印度希望获得欧洲电解槽等技术以发展绿氢和绿色钢铁。印度政府官方访问预告确认了戈亚尔10月22日至24日在柏林参加该对话及讨论印欧FTA市场准入，但没有宣布CBAM豁免、钢铁配额调整或新关税决定。
items.summary_en: India's Commerce and Industry Minister Piyush Goyal criticised EU steel import restrictions, CBAM and other regulatory requirements at the Berlin Global Dialogue on 22 October, arguing that they could raise steel, aluminium, cement and infrastructure costs, weaken European competitiveness and invite reciprocal measures. He also sought European technology for green hydrogen and green steel. India's official visit notice confirms his Berlin participation and India-EU FTA market-access discussions, but announces no CBAM exemption, quota change or new tariff decision.
items.impact_zh: 这是印度政府的公开政策立场和谈判信号，不改变中国钢材现行欧盟配额、50%超配额税或CBAM义务。中国出口商不应据此假定印度将获得豁免、欧盟会撤回措施，或印欧FTA会自动改变中国产品待遇。应继续按现行CN、原产地、配额和排放规则报价，同时跟踪印欧FTA是否形成针对印度钢材的可执行安排及其对欧盟市场竞争格局的影响。
items.impact_en: This is an Indian policy and negotiating position, not a change to EU treatment of Chinese steel. Chinese exporters should not assume an Indian exemption, EU withdrawal or automatic effect from an India-EU FTA. Continue pricing under current CN, origin, quota and emissions rules, while monitoring any enforceable India-specific outcome and its competitive effect in the EU market.

items.summary_zh: SMM 10月22日市场报告称，北欧主要钢厂对2027年2—3月交付的热卷报价为800—830欧元/吨DDP；西北欧热卷评估价维持740欧元/吨EXW，意大利市场降1欧元至743欧元/吨EXW。报道认为终端需求偏弱、库存偏高，同时CBAM证书余额要求占用买方和贸易商流动资金，抑制补库。欧委会CBAM Registry页面确认系统已提供监测“50%规则”的功能；但SMM所称“预购并冻结至少全年义务的50%”是媒体对资金影响的概括，不应替代法规的季度账户余额计算。
items.summary_en: SMM reported on 22 October that major Nordic mills offered HRC for February-March 2027 delivery at EUR 800-830/t DDP; Northwest European HRC was assessed at EUR 740/t EXW and Italian HRC at EUR 743/t EXW, down EUR 1. It attributed weak restocking to soft end demand, high inventories and the working-capital effect of CBAM certificate-balance requirements. The Commission's CBAM Registry page confirms tools for monitoring the '50% rule', but SMM's description of pre-purchasing and freezing 50% of annual obligations is a media characterisation, not a substitute for the legal quarterly account-balance calculation.
items.impact_zh: 这是一份市场报价与采购情绪报告，不是官方基准价格或新法规。对中国热卷出口商而言，欧盟买方可能把CBAM证书持有和融资成本计入报价、付款条件或采购节奏；企业应给客户提供可核查的实际排放资料，并分别测算EXW/DDP、配额和CBAM资金成本。不得把800—830欧元/吨视为全欧统一成交价，也不得据此给中国订单加上固定“50%融资附加费”。
items.impact_en: This is a market and sentiment report, not an official benchmark or new law. EU buyers may incorporate CBAM certificate holdings and financing costs into quotations, payment terms or purchasing schedules. Chinese HRC exporters should provide verifiable actual-emissions data and model EXW/DDP, quota and CBAM working-capital effects separately. Do not treat EUR 800-830/t as a Europe-wide transaction price or add a fixed '50% financing surcharge' to Chinese orders.

items.title_original: UK CBAM: What Hong Kong Traders Need to Know
items.summary_zh: 这是一篇香港贸发局行业解读，并非新法规。文章梳理英国CBAM自2027年1月1日起适用于铝、水泥、化肥、氢及钢铁五个行业；法律责任由英国进口商承担，但境外生产商和香港贸易商需要提供产品与生产装置对应关系、净重、实际隐含排放及已支付碳价等证据，否则进口商可能使用默认值计税。英国进口商在过去12个月或未来30日内受管商品净重达到50,000英镑价值门槛时须注册；2027年首个年度申报期的申报和付款截止日为2028年5月31日，此后改为季度申报。英国政府当前合格碳定价制度名单包含中国全国碳排放权交易市场，但这不等于自动或足额减免：可抵扣金额取决于实际有效碳价及可核验证据，免费配额、补贴或返还会降低可主张金额。
items.summary_en: This is an HKTDC industry explainer, not a new legal measure. It outlines the UK CBAM starting on 1 January 2027 for aluminium, cement, fertiliser, hydrogen and iron and steel. UK importers bear the legal liability, but overseas producers and Hong Kong traders will need product-to-installation links, net mass, verified embedded-emissions data and evidence of carbon prices actually paid; otherwise defaults may be used. Registration applies when relevant imports cross the GBP 50,000 value threshold over the relevant look-back or forward-looking test. The first 2027 return and payment are due on 31 May 2028, followed by quarterly periods. The current UK qualifying-schemes list includes the China National ETS, but relief is not automatic or necessarily full: it depends on the effective price and verified evidence, and is reduced by free allocation, subsidies or rebates.
items.impact_zh: 对向英国出口钢铁、经香港转口或由香港贸易商组织交易的中国企业，重点不是仅向英国客户提供一个企业平均排放数，而是尽快按8位商品编码、生产企业和具体装置建立可追溯数据包，保存净重、实际直接/间接排放边界、核证文件及中国全国碳市场实际支付碳价证明，并在销售合同中明确数据提供、第三方核证、默认值风险、税负转嫁和更正责任。中国全国碳市场被列入合格制度只提供申请减免的制度入口，不能据此在报价中预设固定抵扣额；应由英国进口商依据实际有效碳价和证据申报。英国与欧盟CBAM的申报、价格和认可机制不同，不能直接共用税额结论。
items.impact_en: Chinese steel producers exporting to the UK, including Hong Kong-routed trades, should build traceable data packs by 8-digit commodity code, producer and installation rather than provide only a company-wide average. Retain net mass, boundary-consistent direct and indirect emissions data, verification records and evidence of carbon prices effectively paid under China's national ETS, and allocate data, verification, default-value, pass-through and correction risks in contracts. Inclusion of China's ETS on the qualifying-schemes list creates a route to claim relief but does not justify assuming a fixed credit in pricing; the UK importer must substantiate the effective price. items.title_zh: 南非研究：CBAM冲击取决于产品排放强度与进口价格，不宜只看国家平均值
items.title_en: South African study says CBAM exposure depends on product emissions and import prices, not country averages alone
items.title_original: LAWRENCE EDWARDS AND NICOLA WILLS | The CBAM wake-up call: decarbonisation is now an export survival issue
items.summary_zh: Business Day刊发开普敦大学Lawrence Edwards与Nicola Wills的评论，基于ERSA产品层面局部均衡研究。作者指出，同类产品的排放强度可在国家和企业间显著不同，固定的每吨碳成本对低价、高排放产品造成的价格涨幅更大。其南非情景以80欧元/吨CO₂e并计入直接与间接排放时，模拟钢铁平均欧盟进口价格上升约31%；直接排放情景下南非钢铁进口量约降48%，纳入间接排放后约降76%。这些是南非模型结果，不是对中国产品的税额或销量预测。
items.summary_en: Business Day published commentary by UCT researchers Lawrence Edwards and Nicola Wills based on an ERSA product-level partial-equilibrium study. They argue that emissions vary across products and firms, while a fixed carbon cost causes a larger percentage price increase for cheaper, emissions-intensive goods. In their South African scenario using EUR 80/tCO2e and both direct and indirect emissions, the model raises average EU import prices for iron and steel by about 31%; estimated South African steel imports fall about 48% with direct emissions only and 76% when indirect emissions are included. These are South African model results, not Chinese duty or volume forecasts.
items.impact_zh: 对中国钢厂的可用启示是，应按产品、装置和工艺准备实际排放数据，并把产品单价、排放强度和客户替代弹性一起纳入欧盟报价情景；提升产品附加值可以降低固定碳成本占售价的比例。但不得把文中的31%、48%或76%直接套用于中国订单。若欧盟未来正式纳入更多间接排放，应再依据最终法规、CN范围、实际排放和届时EU ETS价格重算。
items.impact_en: For Chinese mills, the useful lesson is to model EU quotations using product-, installation- and process-level verified emissions together with unit value and demand substitution. Higher-value products may reduce the carbon charge as a share of price. Do not apply the article's 31%, 48% or 76% South African estimates to Chinese orders. Recalculate only against final EU rules, CN scope, actual emissions and the relevant ETS price if indirect-emissions coverage changes.

items.summary_zh: 韩国贸易委员会于2026年9月17日第477次会议对中国合金钢棒作出倾销和产业损害肯定性初裁，并建议财政经济部门在调查期间征收25.08%—27.96%的临时反倾销税。涉案棒材用于汽车、工程机械、造船、轴承和工业机械零部件；申请人为世亚贝斯特与世亚昌原特殊钢，调查对象包括中国大冶、江苏永钢和金腾三组供应商。委员会预计于2027年2月作出终裁。该初裁及建议不等同于临时税已经生效。
items.summary_en: At its 477th meeting on 17 September 2026, the Korea Trade Commission made an affirmative preliminary dumping and injury determination on alloy-steel bars from China and recommended provisional anti-dumping duties of 25.08%–27.96% during the investigation. The bars are used in automotive, construction-equipment, shipbuilding, bearing and industrial-machinery parts. SeAH Besteel and SeAH Changwon Special Steel filed the petition; the investigated supplier groups include Daye, Jiangsu Yonggang and Jinteng. A final determination is planned for February 2027. The preliminary finding and recommendation do not by themselves put provisional duties into force.
items.impact_zh: 对韩出口合金钢棒的中国生产商和贸易商应立即按韩国书面产品范围核对牌号、制造方式、HSK编码、生产商—出口商组合及关联企业，并保存内销、对韩销售、成本和产能数据以应对后续核查。报价和到港安排不得直接套用媒体列示的企业税率；只有韩国财政部门发布实施公告后，才能确认临时税的生效日、征收期和报关适用税率。同步跟踪2027年2月终裁节点。
items.impact_en: Chinese producers and traders exporting alloy-steel bars to Korea should immediately map grades, manufacturing method, HSK codes, producer-exporter combinations and affiliates against the written scope, and preserve home-market sales, Korean sales, cost and capacity data for the continuing investigation. Do not apply media-reported company rates to quotations or arrivals until the Korean finance authority publishes an implementing notice confirming the effective date, collection period and entry rate. Monitor the planned February 2027 final determination.

items.summary_zh: 首钢股份公告编号2026-047显示，公司拟以自有及自筹资金，按5.1269元/股受让首钢智新11家股东合计587,911,257股，占首钢智新总股本19.60%，预计总价不超过30.15亿元。若按拟议范围完成，首钢股份持股比例将由66.23%升至85.83%，仍为控股股东。九届八次董事会已于2026年10月15日通过，关联董事回避表决；交易构成关联交易、不构成重大资产重组，仍须2026年11月3日临时股东会批准，最终股份数量和价款还取决于实际签署协议。
items.summary_en: Announcement No. 2026-047 says Shougang Co. proposes to acquire 587,911,257 shares in Shougang Zhixin from 11 shareholders at CNY 5.1269 per share, representing 19.60% of the subsidiary, for up to CNY 3.015 billion using internal and raised funds. If completed as proposed, its stake would rise from 66.23% to 85.83%. The board approved the related-party transaction on 15 October 2026 with related directors abstaining; it is not a major asset restructuring but still requires approval at the extraordinary shareholders' meeting on 3 November. Final shares and consideration depend on executed agreements.
items.impact_zh: 这项交易首先是控股权和治理结构调整，不等同于新增30.15亿元电工钢产能，也不会直接改变出口关税、CBAM或产品认证。若获批并完成，少数股东权益下降、决策权进一步集中，可能有利于高端取向及无取向电工钢研发、产能升级和全产业链协同；但具体产量、产品组合、资本开支和客户供货变化仍须以后续项目及经营公告为准。业务团队应在11月3日后核对股东会结果及最终协议，再更新对客户的产能和供应判断。
items.impact_en: This is primarily a control and governance transaction, not CNY 3.015 billion of new electrical-steel capacity, and it does not directly change tariffs, CBAM treatment or product approvals. If approved and completed, greater control may support R&D, capacity upgrades and value-chain coordination in high-grade grain-oriented and non-oriented electrical steel, but output, product mix, capex and customer-supply effects require later operating disclosures. Recheck the shareholder vote and final agreements after 3 November before changing customer-facing capacity or supply assumptions.

The UK Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism ( CBAM ) is designed to address the risk of carbon leakage as the UK decarbonises its economy. It does this by applying a carbon price to imported goods in covered sectors that reflects the carbon price faced by comparable domestic production. Unlike most taxes, CBAM does not have a single headline rate set out in primary legislation. Instead, the rate is determined using a methodology that combines recent carbon pricing data, sector-level emissions information and the extent to which domestic producers continue to receive free allowances under the UK Emissions Trading Scheme.
